name: Schedulista – Online Scheduling
author: schedulista

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress site to Schedulista, online scheduling software that lets your clients book appointments with you 24/7, from any device.

Add the [schedulista] shortcode to any page or post:

  • A “Schedule Now” button that opens your Schedulista booking page:
    [schedulista code=”yourbusiness”]
  • An embedded scheduling widget, so clients book without leaving your site:
    [schedulista type=”widget” code=”yourbusiness”]

You don’t need to build the shortcode by hand: copy it, with your business code already filled in, from your Schedulista web settings page.

What you get with Schedulista

  • A beautiful booking page customized with your logo, photos, and colors
  • Automatic appointment reminders by email and text message
  • iPhone and Android apps to manage your calendar on the go
  • Classes and group scheduling
  • Automated follow-up emails, customizable by service type and visit history
  • Two-way Google Calendar sync, payments with Stripe, Zoom video appointments, Mailchimp, and more

>> Learn more about Schedulista features

Who uses Schedulista?

Any business that runs on appointments: salons and barbershops, massage therapists, counselors, personal trainers, acupuncturists, tutors, consultants, and more.

Pricing

Schedulista requires a monthly subscription. New accounts start with a free trial.
>> Sign up for a free trial
>> View pricing

Support

Questions? Email support@schedulista.com and a real human will get back to you quickly.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the built-in WordPress plugin installer (search for “Schedulista”), or upload it manually to “/wp-content/plugins/schedulista-shortcode/”.
  2. Activate Schedulista in the “Plugins” admin panel.
  3. Copy your shortcode from your Schedulista web settings page and paste it into any page or post.
